sentences.en: The government's anti-corruption tsar resigned yesterday following allegations of bribery.
sentences.zh: 1. 在有关受贿的指控出现后，政府反腐沙皇昨天辞职。

sentences.en: I hope you've got some proof to back up your allegations.
sentences.zh: 2. 希望你有一些证据来支持你的指控。

sentences.en: Allegations of sexual impropriety were levelled against the headmaster.
sentences.zh: 3. 校长被控有不当性行为。

senses.zh: 指控; 陈述，主张; 宣称; 陈词，陈述
